messages:
aline (People Ops): Quick thread 1: candidate verbally accepted for Senior Infra Eng. Manager requesting $12k above band + split sign-on (8k at start, 4k at 6mo). Need approval path to close.
sam (Recruiter): Candidate start target 2026-04-15. Comp is sensitive; they have another offer. Can we fast-track?
ken (Hiring Manager): Critical hire for product stability. Happy to sign manager justification. Proposed total comp: base 160k, band cap 148k, over-band +12k. Sign-on structure as above.
liza (Comp & Benefits): Split sign-ons okay but >band requires Director sign-off + Finance review. Please attach manager justification and comparable peers.
aline (People Ops): Filing checklist: 1) manager justification doc 2) comp review 3) Director auth 4) Finance ticket 5) legal clawback language 6) offer PDF.
sam (Recruiter): Justification attached: "unique kernel debugging experience, immediate impact on backlog, competing offer." Also added two internal comparables.
liza (Comp & Benefits): Routing to Marta now. Also flagging that payroll may need a different coding for split payments.
payroll-bot: Created ticket FIN-2026-314 -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-2026-314. Please add approved numbers once final.
marta (Director of Comp): Reviewing docs. If manager provides one-sentence business impact and peer comps, I can approve up to +12k provisional. Need legal to confirm clawback wording.
ken (Hiring Manager): Adding one-liner: "reduces live incident MTTR by >30% via kernel-level fixes; senior on-call expertise not present on team."
aline (People Ops): Thanks. Marta provisional approve noted. Next: Legal review ETA 24-48h; Finance final sign-off ETA 48h after comp approval. Sam, advise candidate timeline accordingly.
sam (Recruiter): Telling candidate we expect formal offer within 72h pending approvals. Will wait for the offer PDF before sending.
liza (Comp & Benefits): After Marta signs, I'll update FIN ticket and confirm payroll code. Also recommend clawback: repayment prorated if leaving before 6 months.
aline (People Ops): Closing notes: once finance confirms, People Ops will generate offer PDF with split sign-on schedule and clawback clause. Keep thread updated. :white_check_mark:
